capabilities: insert date links from an @ autocomplete menu
recognize today, tomorrow, and yesterday in six languages
follow the Obsidian language or set one manually
match keywords ignoring accents and capitalization
add new languages via JSON files
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it supports Spanish, Italian, French, and German, falling back to Spanish.
intentEvidence: Rainbow Aloha is the international companion of Aloha by kepano, which covers English.
problem: Aloha's natural-language date autocomplete only recognizes English words, so non-English speakers have to type dates manually.

relations.evidence: Rainbow Aloha is the international companion of Aloha by kepano, which covers English.
Based on Aloha by kepano, which was inspired by Natural Language Dates.

summary: Natural-language date autocomplete that inserts today, tomorrow, and yesterday as date links in languages other than English.
